title: Chaos in the Artificial Wave Pool — Part 3

series.summary: When the water park's artificial wave machine roars to life, playful waves quickly turn into a raging surge. Shizuka loses hold of her float ring and gets swept into the churning deep end, prompting Rentaro to leap straight into the treacherous current to save her life.

segments.description: Warning alarms sound as the wave generator begins pumping massive swells through the indoor pool.
segments.voiceover_text: A sudden siren echoes through the water park as the artificial wave machine powers up, generating towering, churning swells.

segments.description: Swimmers cheer in the swelling water, while Shizuka floats gently near the edge on her inner tube.
segments.voiceover_text: While throngs of swimmers gleefully ride the rising swell, tiny Shizuka floats peacefully on her small inflatable inner tube.

segments.description: A violent rogue wave flips Shizuka off her float ring and drags her toward the deep current.
segments.voiceover_text: Suddenly, an unexpectedly violent wave flips Shizuka into the deep water, violently separating her from her only safety float.

segments.description: Shizuka struggles underwater as the girls shout in horror from the poolside deck.
segments.voiceover_text: Unable to swim, Shizuka desperately gasps for air beneath the churning foam as panicked screams erupt across the deck.

segments.description: Rentaro spots Shizuka sinking and launches himself headfirst into the turbulent waves without a second thought.
segments.voiceover_text: Spotting his beloved soulmate drowning, Rentaro rockets into the raging water with superhuman speed to rescue his precious girl.
